integrity: Self-review only; verification checks finite cases and neither guarantees novelty nor constitutes independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to full commuting graphs of M_2 over finite commutative chain rings. Comparison with Zhang (2021) identifies prior modular-ring branching and automorphism results; a broader unlocated theorem could cover the classification. Full texts of older 2008 and 2010 finite-field works were not inspected. The general proof, not finite verification, covers all parameters. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Commuting-graph universality across finite chain-ring matrix algebras
